text:
(2) Subsection (1)(c) applies however the enactment is expressed so that (for instance) it
applies in the case of—
(a) [F107paragraph 10 of Schedule 2 to the M42Sexual Offences Act 1956
(prosecution for certain offences may not be commenced more than 12 months
after offence);]
(b) section 127(1) of the M43Magistrates’ Courts Act 1980 (magistrates’ court not
to try information unless it is laid within 6 months from time when offence
committed);
(c) an enactment that imposes a time limit only in certain circumstances (as where
proceedings are not instituted by or with the consent of the Director of Public
Prosecutions).
Extent Information
E17 In its application to Northern Ireland, this section has effect subject to the modifications set out in
Schedule 4; see s. 79
